title: we should be all anti kickstarter scams like these
author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
selftext:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mujYKr1vHvg

[*we should all be*] they have a website, a Kickstarter and the whole social media going. 

look, I am not here to tell you now to make a video game, I am currently working on an mmo myself, but making these no effort 1 shot prompts and then going out of your way to make kickstarter to scam people of their money, you should probably have a hard look at the mirror and come to the terms that your "game" is pure garbage and nothing more than a rug pull that most everybody can see from a mile away, and you are only damaging the path for the rest of us that are actually developing games, with iterations and work actually required make stuff enjoyable. 

if your game looks like the pure garbage from above, do not try to rug people into wasting their money and time and instead work on the foundation of your "game". 

I am always searching for solo / indie games on YouTube so the fact that this garbage came up on my screen gave me second hand embarrassment.

you are quite literally giving fuel to all the people who are already anti slop anti AI.

comments.author: GraphXGames
comments.body: This is a prototype, after all.

replies.author: meowyih
replies.body: And built in one hour using AI.

replies.author: GraphXGames
replies.body: Come on, AI could do a better job.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: friend, when you speak badly about other peoples' games, [people will look at the quality of your games](https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GraphXGames/)

replies.author: GraphXGames
replies.body: No problem. Games are meant to be judged.

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body:
i wish people in this sub wouldn't obsess over gatekeeping and trying to generate torch mobs

leave the novice alone, they're doing the best they can

this is supposed to be a sub about game development.  it is okay for people to be new at the craft, and i guarantee someone has thought this about your work too.

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: i think you are missing a S/ there is no way any people using AI would actually support this cash grab. unless you are also in it to scam for money. which would make sense for the downvotes

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
everything you post in here is being critical of someone else, or posting lame button push memes.

please try to be less of a stereotype.

i kind of doubt you've ever released anything

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: are you also a Slopper making slop scam to get money? would actually make sense.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
no, i am not a "slopper" and i am not making a "slop scam."  my game has over two thousand hours of work into it and is mostly hand coded.  

are you able to stop guess-judging total strangers based on zero evidence?  this is so tacky and so bad for the community.

it seems like you're throwing around insults based on nothing other than someone asking you to stop insulting other people

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: there is nothing good for the community having sloppers trying to make a quick buck with a 1 prompt garbage.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: please stop constantly throwing insults at strangers.  this is very bad for the community.

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: nobody is throwing insults you can stop the act buddy.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
oh dear, he's pretending that calling people sloppers and saying their work is bad for the community isn't an insult.

at this point it's clear that you aren't able to read the room.  i've requested intercession.

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: there is nothing wrong with calling the above work mentioned in my OP slop, it is slop and if you are feeling offended due to that, it says more about you and your game than anything else. o/

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
why would it say anything about my game that i think you're being pointlessly mean to someone at the beginning of their journey?

you're acting like you're some kind of wizened authority that we all look up to

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body:
it has nothing to do with beginnings,  I have only spoken the truth about a "game" that clearly no effort has been made other than "make me a game, make no mistakes" and then expecting people to pay you money for it. 

I am no authority, but as someone also using AI as a tool it gives me personally second hand embarament that anybody would actually try do commercialize a 1 shot prompts scamming people.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: have you ever considered that most people won't care about your secondhand embarrassment, and that all the replies you got were not agreeing with you?

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: if you get triggered for calling garbage AI slop garbage, that's on you.  I have no problem calling out good games and bad ones. specially when they are trying to scam money.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
i'm not triggered, but i think it's very telling that you're starting to use phrasing like that.

who else says that?

do you feel that they're good company for you to be in?

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: since when is using the phrase AI Slop banned? let me know when garbage games cannot be called out for being obvious garbage and scam thank you o/

replies.author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
replies.body: but you just called StoneCypher a slopper, which is an insult.

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: did I? pretty sure I just asked a question o/

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: Even Wikipedia calls this "[JAQing off](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Just_asking_questions)"

replies.author: Undeathical
replies.body:
Your Reddit is a week old... I feel like you are just trying to troll people. Yeah, the game looks bad now, but it can be improved as time goes on. If you want to criticize, make it constructive. Point out the issues, add suggestions. 

If you can't do that, then ignore it. Bitching about it for the sake of bitching is just going to make you look like an asshole.

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: I did, it's a scam and should be removed and remade.  in my opinion, yes I am welcomed to have my own opinions, these one shot sloppers trying to monitize on Kickstarter and other platforms are making it difficult for the rest of us that put quality into our games.

replies.author: Undeathical
replies.body: Its a scam because it looks bad? I think you dont understand the definition of what a scam is. Unless he is lying about his project, maliciously lying, it's not a scam. You are free to your own opinion, but when you voice it publicly, prepare for the backlash

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: it's a scam because it is? 1 prompt shot, zero effort into desloppofying the game, zero effort into making a quality video, asking people for money for maybe a one paragraph prompt? unlike (apparently) the downvoters here I could care less for any backlash you can send my way o/

replies.author: SafeByte12
replies.body: If you could care less then why don't you?

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: against me go ahead, I will proudly and furiously claim the AI slop I  mentioned in OP is garbage and net negative to people putting the effort into their games.  any game that remotely looks the same will also go on the same category o/

replies.author: Undeathical
replies.body:
Oh, I didnt realize you were with him as he was creating the game. Im  sorry, you would of course know exactly how much effort he put in to get the game to where its at now...

/s

You are assuming to justify a point that has no weight at all. It's literally you complaining just because you dont like it. Who made you the judge and jury of what a quality game is anyhow? Maybe your projects are worse that the guy you are dragging through the mud? You are getting downvoted for being an asshole with no merit to your complaint, other than the point you made of not liking it. If you want to bully others for their work, then I guess you should also be prepared to get bullied back, right?

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: I am being downvoted for calling shit garbage AI slop garbage, seems people get triggered by the word and take offense to themselves, I wonder why ☺️

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: it's genuinely not okay for you to publicly demand that other people be removed

comments.author: desdinovait
comments.body: If someone wants to put money on this sh\*t it’s free to do it

comments.author: SlightOfHand_
comments.body: If bro wants to try and monetize baby’s first programming exercise, let him try and fail. He poses no risk to anyone and will only waste his own time.

comments.author: Obvious_Catch_3034
comments.body: Making a crappy novice or sloppy game isn't a "scam". Have you not seen browser games, itch, or gamejolt pre ai? The game you posted is obviously going to fail. Is every crappy game in your mind a cash grab?

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: personally speaking, scams and cash grabs are the same to me.  the OP slop I shared I consider to be a scam. for the many reasons I have already discussed. like I said, I don't mind people making their games, I do mind when people try to monitize obvious scams.

replies.author: Obvious_Catch_3034
replies.body: If their intention was truly to make the game they envision (even if they lack the skill) with backing. Not just grab the money and run. Would you still consider that a scam?

replies.author: Smooth_Werewolf_1485
replies.body: based on the effort shown? yes it's very apparent that they don't give a fuck about their product.

comments.author: KnightFury2026
comments.body:
I think being against anyone trying to sell something is wrong. You think this is a rug pull, and you might be right. Also, this person could really believe in what they are making and being trying as hard as they can. Quality level != commitment, etc.  I agree that scammers shouldn't be highlighted or not be called out, but unless this guy has done rug pulls in the past, then I don't think calling out a solo dev who is trying to make a game is good for anyone.   
  AI devs are constantly hounded by people popping in just to say they are shit, or their game is shit, etc. so I don't think trying to dog pile someone because of quality of game isn't up to your preference or level is a good thing.

replies.author: Stinky_You
replies.body: I'm pretty new to the sub -glad to see comments like this. Not that I'm posting anything I've made, but experienced devs products are going to start popping up with better and better quality IMO. Nobody is making quality content overnight and the people making overnight content are still going to have to learn the process eventually or be left in the dust

replies.author: KnightFury2026
replies.body:
Yeah, I understand wanting to try and not give Anti-AI people fuel to throw the word Slop around for AI Game Dev, but at the same time, those people generally don't know or have some block on how Games are developed and can't get around themselves on game developers using AI to try to better achieve their overall vision. I understand OPs stance on calling this out, but I also try to err on the side of assuming someone isn't trying to rug pull, etc.  
On your work, you keep making it. Hold it to your own standard, and also there is so much content on how to achieve your end goal with AI that you should be able to quickly get things together and see how they play, etc.  It's never been better to enter the field IMO.

comments.author: Stinky_You
comments.body: Bro focus on yourself and your product. This is wasted energy
